title: PDF Editor: Edit Text in a PDF Online, Free
description: Free PDF editor in your browser: click a paragraph to change or delete text, add text boxes and images, find and replace. No upload, no account.
promise: A free PDF editor that changes the text itself: click a paragraph, retype it, and the lines reflow. Your file never leaves your device.
